name: Offer page exposes accept, reject, payment frequency, expiry and the offer options
description:
Objective: Offer page exposes accept, reject, payment frequency, expiry and the offer options.
Preconditions: Open Offer review with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Offer review.
2. Offer page exposes accept, reject, payment frequency, expiry and the offer options.
